ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 55% high-intensity (white) pixels to 45% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a large, contiguous white geometric blob bounded by a dark leading edge and trailing margin. Right lobe exhibits a high-contrast mottled pattern with a central dark mass extending from the peduncle, fragmented by white regions containing dark vertical striations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate pixel-derived interior angle of 55 degrees; notch depth is roughly 1/6th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits small, high-frequency serrations with pixel amplitudes of 2-5 pixels; distal tips show extreme topographic variation and high-amplitude irregular clusters due to barnacle encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, sweeping from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of roughly circular high-contrast pixel groups located at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered white punctate clusters are visible on the dark central peduncle surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions on the right lobe, most notably a horizontal mark in the lower-right quadrant and two diagonal marks in the upper-right white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the tips of both lobes, significantly altering the 2D geometric silhouette of the fluke margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark pigmentation mark in the shape of a trident or 'Y' located in the upper-right quadrant of the right fluke lobe.
